plan.line: a photoresistor (LDR) that measures how bright it is around it; a 10 kΩ resistor is added automatically. Brighter light gives a higher reading. Use it for light and dark: a night light, a light meter, a sunrise alarm. Uses one of the three ADC pins (shared with knobs).

code.pinLine: light sensor (photoresistor) {ref} on {gpio}: ADC({g}). read_u16() gives 0..65535: higher in brighter light, lower in the dark (often about 5000 in a dark room and over 50000 in daylight, depending on the room). Not Pin({g}): a Pin has no read_u16(). Find the dark/bright threshold by printing the readings first, or compare with a reading taken at start.
